body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and swap spaces with the target, if both spaces can hold their new occupants.

surges.html: After swapping, move 1 unit without triggering the target's movement Reactions.
The target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Blitz
rider.html: After a successful swap, gain 1 additional Combo if the target now stands beside an obstacle or another enemy.
